# EMFLS Statutory Financial, Tax & FinOps Calculators — Complete Reference Index (llms-full.txt)

> Comprehensive machine-readable directory of 662 verified, indexable, self-canonical, client-side statutory calculators and 12 pillar hubs across the United States (IRS / OBBBA / SECURE 2.0), United Kingdom (HMRC 2026/27), Australia (ATO FY2026-27), Canada (CRA 2026/27), South Korea (NTS / MOEL / MOHW 2026), and Global Finance / AI FinOps. Last verified: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 00:00:00 +0000.

## 2026/2027 Statutory Parameter Reference Summary

### United States (IRS 2026 — Rev. Proc. 2025-32, OBBBA & SECURE 2.0)
- Federal Income Tax Brackets: 10%, 12%, 22%, 24%, 32%, 35%, 37% (indexed for 2026).
- Retirement & Healthcare Caps: 401(k)/403(b) elective deferral $24,500 (age 50+ catch-up $8,000; ages 60–63 super catch-up $11,250); IRA $7,500; HSA $4,400 self / $8,750 family.
- Payroll & Business: SSA OASDI wage base $184,500; Section 179 expensing cap $2,560,000 ($4,090,000 phase-out, $32,000 Heavy SUV limit); 100% OBBBA bonus depreciation.
- Estate & Medicaid: Federal estate/gift lifetime exemption $15,000,000 per individual ($30M married); Medicaid 5-year (60-month) look-back penalty divisor rules.

### United Kingdom (HMRC 2026/27)
- Income Tax & NI: Personal Allowance £12,570 (tapered £1 per £2 above £100,000 -> 60% marginal trap); Higher rate 40% (>£50,270); Additional rate 45% (>£125,140); Employer NIC 15% above £5,000.
- Capital Gains & Dividends: Standard CGT 18%/24% (£3,000 AEA); BADR 18% on £1M lifetime cap in 2026/27; 2026/27 Dividend tax rates 10.75% / 35.75% / 39.35%.
- Property & Inheritance: England/NI SDLT standard nil-rate band £125,000 with 5% additional property surcharge (5%–17%, +2% non-UK resident); IHT £325,000 NRB + £175,000 RNRB; HMCTS probate fee £526.

### Australia (ATO FY2026-27)
- Resident Income Tax (Stage 3): $0–$18,200 (0%), $18,201–$45,000 (16%), $45,001–$135,000 (30%), $135,001–$190,000 (37%), >$190,000 (45%) + 2% Medicare Levy.
- Superannuation & Business: Super Guarantee 12.0%; Concessional cap $30,000; Non-concessional cap $120,000; Div 293 threshold $250,000; ATO Div 7A benchmark interest rate 8.77%; Small Business CGT $6M MNAV / $2M turnover / $500k retirement exemption.

### Canada (CRA 2026/27)
- Registered Accounts: FHSA $8,000/yr ($40,000 lifetime, tax-free, zero repayment); RRSP HBP $60,000/buyer ($120,000/couple) with extended 5-year grace period; TFSA indexed annual room.
- Capital Gains & Business: Lifetime Capital Gains Exemption (LCGE) indexed to $1,275,000 for QSBC shares; 2026 Federal AMT rate 20.5%.

### South Korea (NTS / MOEL / MOHW 2026)
- Labor & Social Insurance: 2026 minimum wage KRW 10,320/hr (monthly 209h KRW 2,156,880); National Pension 9.5% total (4.75% employee/employer); National Health Insurance 3.595% + Long-Term Care 13.14%.
- Tax & Property: Overseas stock capital gains KRW 2.5M annual deduction + 22% tax; Financial income comprehensive taxation > KRW 20M; Marriage/childbirth gift tax exemption up to KRW 150M per child (KRW 300M couple); Industrial accident compensation daily cap KRW 268,299 / floor KRW 82,560.
